name: ec2-instance-connect:SendSSHPublicKey
description: Use ec2-instance-connect:SendSSHPublicKey to push a temporary SSH public key to a running EC2 instance, SSH in within the 60-second validity window, and extract the instance role's temporary credentials from IMDS. If the role has IAM write permissions, the stolen credentials can be used to elevate the starting principal to administrator.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target EC2 instance ID (instance must have EC2 Instance Connect enabled)

additional.description: Discover running instances with privileged roles
View instance profile to assess attached role permissions
View role permissions before attempting exploitation

admin: A running EC2 instance with an IAM instance profile that has administrative permissions
The instance must have EC2 Instance Connect installed and the OS user must exist (ec2-user for Amazon Linux)
The instance must have a public IP address reachable from the operator's machine
SSH port 22 must be accessible from the operator's network
lateral: A running EC2 instance with an IAM instance profile that has permissions useful for lateral movement
The instance must have EC2 Instance Connect installed
The instance must have a public IP address and SSH port accessible

references.title: HackTricks - AWS EC2 Privesc via Instance Connect

techniques: T1552.005 - Unsecured Credentials: Cloud Instance Metadata API

options.name: INSTANCE_ID
options.description: Target EC2 instance ID (must have a public IP and EC2 Instance Connect enabled)

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region where the target instance runs

options.name: EC2_USER
options.description: OS user to authenticate as on the instance (ec2-user for Amazon Linux, ubuntu for Ubuntu)

options.name: TARGET_USER
options.description: IAM user name to attach AdministratorAccess to using the stolen instance role credentials (optional)

options.name: SSH_TIMEOUT
options.description: SSH connection timeout in seconds (must complete before the 60-second key expiry)
